Name: Msdeploy.exe
Description: Microsoft tool used to deploy Web Applications.
Author: Oddvar Moe
Created: 2018-05-25
Commands:

    Description: Launch .bat file via msdeploy.exe.
    Usecase: Local execution of batch file using msdeploy.exe.

    Privileges: User
